bar.empty: Headroom: no Claude, Codex or Antigravity sign-in found

auth.body: The provider rejected the saved sign-in.
auth.title: Sign-in rejected

network.body: Check your connection. Headroom retries automatically.
network.title: Can't reach the provider

no_plan.body: This account's plan doesn't include usage limits Headroom can read. Headroom checks again hourly.
no_plan.title: No quota on this plan

parse.body: The usage format may have changed. Please report this.
parse.title: Unexpected response

rate_limited.body: The usage endpoint asked us to slow down. Headroom retries automatically.
rate_limited.title: Throttled

server.body: The provider had a problem. Headroom retries automatically.
server.title: Service error

notify.reset_body: You have your headroom back: now at {percent}%.
notify.title: {provider} usage is running low

panel.empty_body: Headroom reads the sign-ins of Claude Code, the Codex CLI and Antigravity. Sign in to any of them and it shows up here automatically.

antigravity.hint: Run `agy` once and sign in with Google.

claude.hint: Run `claude` once to sign in or renew the session.

codex.hint: Run `codex login` and sign in with ChatGPT.

brand_colors.description: Color healthy meters with each provider's brand color instead of the theme's primary color.
brand_colors.label: Display · Brand colors

critical_percent.description: Usage at or above this percentage is shown in the error color and can notify you.
critical_percent.label: Display · Critical at (%)

disabled_providers.description: Provider ids Headroom ignores entirely: never fetched, never shown. Available: claude, codex, antigravity.
disabled_providers.label: Data · Disabled providers

display.description: Whether percentages and meters show how much you've used or how much is left. Colors and warnings always follow usage.
display.label: Display · Show

max_providers.description: How many providers this capsule shows at most. When more are signed in, the ones closest to their limits win.
max_providers.label: Bar · Maximum providers

notify.description: Notify once per window when usage crosses the critical threshold.
notify.label: Alerts · Running low

notify_reset.description: Notify when a window that reached the critical threshold resets, so you know you're back.
notify_reset.label: Alerts · Window reset

pace_colors.description: Use the warning color when a window is on course to run out well before it resets, even below the warning threshold.
pace_colors.label: Display · Forecast colors

provider.description: Which providers the bar shows. Pick one to pin it.
provider.label: Bar · Providers

refresh_minutes.description: How often to fetch usage from each provider, in minutes. Failures retry sooner with backoff.
refresh_minutes.label: Data · Refresh interval (min)

show_countdown.description: Show the time until the displayed window resets next to the percentage (horizontal bars only).
show_countdown.label: Bar · Show reset countdown

warn_percent.description: Usage at or above this percentage is shown in the warning color.
warn_percent.label: Display · Warning at (%)

window.description: Which usage window the bar shows for each provider.
window.label: Bar · Window
